description: This file defines the SkillRegistry class responsible for managing a collection of skills, allowing registration, inclusion of skills from a router, retrieval, and listing of all skills.

classes.name: SkillRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages a registry of skills, providing methods to register, include, retrieve, and list skills.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new skill with a given name, handler, and optional options.

methods.name: includeRouter
methods.description: Includes skills from an external AgentRouter into the registry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a skill by its name.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered skills.

ctags.name: skills
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly skills = new Map<string, SkillDefinition>();$/

fields.name: private readonly skills = new Map<string, SkillDefinition>();
